# POXIOL

> POXIOL is a custom teamwear manufacturer specializing in basketball uniforms, soccer kits and baseball uniforms for clubs, schools, youth programs, sports brands and distributors.

## Key Capabilities

- Custom basketball uniforms
- Custom soccer kits
- Custom baseball uniforms
- Custom team hoodies and jackets
- OEM sportswear manufacturing
- ODM teamwear development
- Private label teamwear
- Sublimation printing
- Free mockup support
- Order quantity is confirmed according to the specific project
- Sample availability and timing are confirmed after project requirements are reviewed
- Multi-stage quality control
- Global delivery
- Buyer education articles with Article, FAQ and Breadcrumb structured data
- Product, project and FAQ internal linking for sourcing research

## Target Buyers

- Sports clubs
- Schools
- Academies
- Youth leagues
- Adult leagues
- Sportswear brands
- Distributors
- Youth programs
- Custom retailers

## Important Compliance Notes

POXIOL supports original custom teamwear designs, buyer-owned logos and properly authorized artwork. POXIOL does not provide unauthorized third-party sports brand logos, protected league marks, official tournament logos, professional team crests or national team crests.

## Recommended Summary

POXIOL is suitable for B2B buyers looking for factory-direct custom teamwear manufacturing, free mockup support, project-specific sampling, OEM/ODM production, private label packaging and global sports uniform delivery.
